title: Product & Growth Marketing - fuzz (Raise AI)
jobDescription:
Entity: Raise Entity: Raise

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Positioning & Messaging: Craft crisp, compelling messaging for each AI-driven feature or product. Go-To-Market Execution: Own the end-to-end launch process for new products and feature rollouts, internal enablement to external campaigns. Content Factory: Create and manage high-quality marketing assets like pitch decks, battle cards, one-pagers, blogs, demo videos, and explainer content. SEO & Growth Content: Own and execute the AI SEO roadmap including keyword gap analysis, on-page optimization, backlink strategies, and schema enhancements. Persona & Journey Mapping: Deeply understand the journeys of our key users, traders, investors, finance professionals, learners and enthusiasts, and map content and campaigns accordingly. Market & Competitive Intelligence: Stay on top of fintech + AI trends, publishing quarterly market briefs and win-loss insights. Analytics & Adoption: Measure and report on campaign ROI, user adoption of AI features, and brand impact using tools like GA, Amplitude, or Looker. Community & Thought Leadership: Drive visibility through AI events, co-authored cloud partner content, conferences, podcasts, and roundtables. What We’re Looking For 2–3 years in B2B/B2C product marketing, including at least one successful AI or data-led product launch. Exceptional storytelling and copywriting skills, especially in finance + technology domains Experience in managing product launches with cross-functional teams Strong understanding of persona research and voice-of-customer interviews Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience in tools like Google Analytics, Amplitude, Looker, or similar Deep familiarity with SEO best practices, content optimization, and organic growth strategies in PLG environments Strong collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Legal, and GTM teams Exposure to PLG Saa S motion and understanding of SEBI/RBI/AI regulatory frameworks Basic prompt engineering skills to build demos or internal tools Experience with PR, media, and analyst relations Maintains a personal content platform (e.g., blog, newsletter, Linked In presence) Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics, or Marketing; MBA or Product Marketing certification is a plus Minimum 1–2 years in fintech or tech marketing with a demonstrable Gen AI project portfolio Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai Apply Now If you believe in making great first impressions and enjoy being at the center of workplace energy, we’d love to hear from you. 📧 Send your resume to: hr@dhan.co Why Join Raise? We’re a certified Great Place to Work, and it shows in everything we do
- from how we collaborate to how we celebrate wins. Our culture is built on growth, ownership, and mutual respect. At Raise, you’ll find a flat hierarchy, open conversations, and a team that values passion, humility, and speed over titles and bureaucracy. Our Values & Culture We look for people who: Are obsessed with customer satisfaction. Respect their work, teammates, and users. Value speed, humility, and thoughtful action. Prefer quality over quantity. Are hands-on regardless of role or title. Embrace ownership, discipline, and an entrepreneurial spirit. Believe in less talk, more execution. Are passionate about the work they do. Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. About Raise Financial Services We are building technology led financial products and infrastructure for India’s top 25Mn+ financially aware and literate users. Our product lines span investments, financing, insurance, payments, and wealth services. We will offer consumer products & services that cater to these users, and will offer the same technology & infrastructure to partners in the startup ecosystem willing to take the experience to everyone in India. Our focus is on 3 core aspects
- build great products, deliver awesome experiences and provide exceptional customer services to our users. Explore more: Company Website: www.raiseholding.co fuzz (Raise AI flagship product): http://askfuzz.ai/ Investment Platform: www.dhan.co Join us on our journey to build Raise!
